issue_context.title: Changes in `Indexes` resources
issue_context.body:
## Specifications

- Naming changes: https://github.com/meilisearch/specifications/pull/140
- Paginate the resource: https://github.com/meilisearch/specifications/pull/138 in the `text/0132-indexes-api.md` file

## Changes

- [x] Remove the `name` field in every response of the `/indexes` endpoints
- [x] Paginate the resources
  - [x] Return the `Indexes` API resources on `GET - /indexes` in an array in a `results` field
  - [x] Add `limit` (Default: `20`) and `offset`(Default: `0`) query parameters.
  - [x] Add `limit`, `offset` and `total` in the response body.

Pinging @meilisearch/integration-team @meilisearch/docs-team
